codeReview.summary: Thorough migration of the vanilla JS template generator to React. All 15 templates produce identical output to the original JS version. The implementation correctly uses shadcn/ui components (Command/Combobox, Tabs, Button, Input, Badge), React Hook Form for dynamic fields, Sonner for toast notifications, and separates pure logic in src/lib/templates.ts from React components. Code quality is high with good TypeScript typing, proper error handling, comprehensive test coverage (47 tests), and adherence to project conventions.

issues.description: Uses alert() for error handling in the catch block of handleGenerate. The handoff notes 'Use toast via event since we don't want to import toast in this module', but a direct toast import would be more consistent with the rest of the codebase which uses Sonner toasts everywhere. The OutputPanel already imports toast from 'sonner'. This is minor since errors should be rare (template.generate is well-tested), and the comment explains the reasoning.

Subject extraction uses a regex replace(/^Subject:.+\n/, '') which only removes one line. If the subject line contained multi-line content (unlikely but possible), only the first line would be stripped. This matches the vanilla JS behavior, so it's not a regression.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The feature stores selectedTemplate in localStorage directly (TemplateGeneratorPage.tsx:38,53,55) rather than through a shared state utility. While this is acceptable since it's UI state (not profile data), it represents a pattern that's inconsistent with the profile data convention documented in AGENTS.md. No action needed — just noting the pattern exists for UI state persistence.

The frontend-worker skill step 4 says to read 'src/js/ui.js' for template page migration. However, the actual UI logic for the vanilla template generator is spread across multiple files (src/js/ui.js, src/js/templates.js, index.html). The worker correctly studied all relevant files. The skill's guidance is accurate but could be more specific about which files to study for template features.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Skill step 4 lists 'src/js/ui.js, src/js/templates.js, index.html' — worker transcript shows it read all three plus AGENTS.md and mission context

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker added 'cmdk' as a dependency (package.json) for the shadcn Command component, which was not previously in the project. This was necessary for the searchable template selector and is now a project dependency. The shadcn component files (command.tsx, popover.tsx) were also added. This dependency information should be tracked in the library.

summary: The template-generator-page feature is well-implemented and passes scrutiny. All 15 templates produce identical output to the vanilla JS version, verified by comparing template body strings side-by-side. The implementation uses the correct shadcn/ui components (Command/Combobox for search, Tabs for Preview/Text, Button, Input, Badge), React Hook Form with profile auto-fill, Sonner toasts, and properly separates pure template logic from React components. 47 tests cover templates.ts pure functions, all 4 React components, and integration flow. TypeScript compiles cleanly. Two non-blocking issues noted: use of alert() instead of toast for generation errors (minor, explained by comment), and a theoretical edge case in subject line extraction (matches vanilla JS behavior). No convention violations detected. Skill procedure was followed correctly.
